kernel_interface_proposal.mask_storage: After upstream normalization, oversized masks are sampled using a flat image-sized extent, not their larger logical row/plane geometry; the safe oversized-mask cases freeze this distinction.
kernel_interface_proposal.namespace: Parent-owned real filters.rank exposure plus generic alias routing; workers own dedicated kernel/binding/helper files, no shared namespace edits.
kernel_interface_proposal.optimization: Maintain population and weighted sum incrementally; min/max occupied-bin summaries avoid per-pixel65536-bin scans. Precompute directional footprint enter/leave offsets. SIMD mask/edge discovery and independent nonalias worker stripes reuse global execution policy.
kernel_interface_proposal.output: uint8/uint16/float32/float64 view with explicit spatial/output-vector strides. Respect provided output shape/sentinel cells. Scalar kernel writes channel0;2D squeeze may then fail after writes if depth>1.
kernel_interface_proposal.prepared_inputs: Dense C-order uint8/uint16 image; binary same-rank footprint; optional normalized uint8 mask; rank2/3 shape; explicit center vector; histogram bins256 foruint8 ormax(3,max(image))+1 foruint16.
kernel_interface_proposal.statistics: Use intp-width histogram counts/weighted sums and float64 population to reproduce pinned casts; preserve fractional floating output means and unsigned sum/population wrap. Empty neighborhoods yield0.
kernel_interface_proposal.worker_policy: Existing sole process-global setter/getter; default1, optional4. Do not introduce per-extension state in integrated core.
kernel_interface_proposal.wrapper: Freeze warning/error order, dtype conversion, readonly/contiguity checks, signed-char shifts and post-write errors before binding native kernels.2Dbool rejects;3Dbool converts.
